song_craft: Vanguard song (26v): vanguard-devotion in three movements — approaching touches (vv1–8: brush/scruff/dust/dumb/Ah-cry/gape/mountain/town/lotus) → tasting deepens (vv9–17: wax/pot-lids/oozing/lake/offering/glance/straws/unparted/fitness) → vows and vastness (vv18–26: foot-place/perfume/clash/frenzy/vanguard/unre-said/vast/dust/sole-touchers). Rasa names it bhakti-as-vanguard (v22).
